title: Formal approximation along the punctured power-series zero section
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $d>0$, set $B=A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and let $z:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y=\operatorname{Spec}B$ be induced by constant coefficient [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $V\subset Y$ be open with $z^{-1}(V)=\operatorname{Spec}A\setminus\{\mathfrak m_A\}$. Write $U=z^{-1}(V)$ and $z_V:U\to V$ for the restriction of $z$. For $x\in U$, write $g_x:\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)\to\mathcal O_{V,z_V(x)}$ for the germ map. Let $r:B\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ be canonical restriction and $J_x=\ker(\mathcal O_{V,z_V(x)}\to\mathcal O_{U,x})$. For every $s\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ there is a unique $b\in B$ such that $g_x(s-r(b))\in J_x^n$ for every $x\in U$ and $n\ge0$.

proof.text: At each order n choose a representative f_n using finite-order lifting. All choices are local to this proof of a proposition; no definition is constructed from mere existence.

Naturality of ΓSpecIso and of global-section restriction identifies the constant-coefficient map on restricted global sections. Naturality of germs and stalk maps makes each variable germ lie in the zero-section stalk kernel. Ideal.span_le, pow_le_pow_left', and Ideal.le_comap_pow therefore send each I^n into J_x^n. This is the proved private helper powerSeries_variables_pow_germs, requiring only a commutative coefficient ring.

For m≤n subtract the residual germ of f_m from that of f_n. Monotonicity of ideal powers makes the result lie in every J_x^m. Finite-order reflection gives f_m-f_n in I^m, so the representatives form an I-adic Cauchy sequence.

The variable ideal is adically complete by the Mathlib instance. Apply IsPrecomplete.prec to obtain b with f_n-b in I^n for every n. The proved forward germ implication sends these differences into J_x^n; adding the residual germs of f_n proves that b approximates s at every order.

For any other approximation c subtract its residual germs from those of b. Finite-order reflection puts c-b in every I^n. Apply IsHausdorff.eq_iff_smodEq from variable-ideal separatedness to conclude c=b.

theorem existsUnique_powerSeries_punctured_formal_approximation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) :
    let z := Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))
    let r := ((ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).inv ≫ V.ι.appTop).hom
    ∀ s : Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤), ∃! b : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A,
      ∀ (x : (z ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (n : ℕ),
        (V.toScheme.presheaf.Γgerm ((z ∣_ V) x)).hom (s - r b) ∈
          (RingHom.ker ((z ∣_ V).stalkMap x).hom) ^ n
